post.title: I Tried to Hang Up 5 Times #shorts
post.description: Who ends your calls: you, or them? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend whose goodbyes take ten minutes. You've wanted to end the call for ten minutes, but nobody says it. In 'Do conversations end when people want them to?' (PNAS, 2021), Adam Mastroianni, Daniel Gilbert, Gus Cooney and Timothy Wilson asked people about 932 conversations: only about 2% ended when both people wanted them to, and people were far off at guessing how long their partner wanted to talk. So say it kindly. They might be relieved. #psychology #shorts #overthinking #conversation #socialanxiety
